name: moe_dq4_rotate_v1
hypothesis: The original funnel-shift E2M1 decoder may compete better on H200 than the DQ7 layout's extra IMAD instructions under WGS register pressure.
result: Reference checker failed at relative L2 1.411. Candidate packing switched to rotate layout but CUDA decoder remained on DQ7. Retained as the failed setup record; corrected in moe_dq4_rotate_v2.
change: Disable DQ7 weight layout and use original rotate-based bit placement and decode.
